`ENV_MPI_ROOT` is supposed to be the path to the location of the MPI package we're using. So something like `/home/lucas/openmpi`. `MPI_Fortran_COMPILER` is an automatically set variable that gives the path to the fortran compiler, i.e. `/home/lucas/openmpi/bin/mpifort`. So the reason we have 2 lines here is that each one goes down 1 directory level so that the end state of `ENV_MPI_ROOT` is `/home/lucas/openmpi`.

Note that the only purpose of most of the `ENV_X` variables, including `ENV_MPI_ROOT`, is to fill in the details that get printed when you run `mcnp6 -v` with MCNP versions 6.1.1 or 6.2.

So, the way this is set up does depend on the fortran compiler being exactly 2 levels below the base MPI path. This is the way OpenMPI and MPICH both operate by default. But regardless, the worst thing that would happen if this doesn't work correctly is that a wrong path will be printed when you run `mcnp6 -v`.
